data.one_liner: Material Design layout tool for responsive breakpoints, columns, and spacing across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Layout widget, breakpoints, fluid margins, and adaptive builders to implement responsive layouts following Material Design guidelines. It calculates screen constraints to let developers adapt UI components across different screen sizes.
use_when: You want to implement responsive layouts based on Material Design breakpoints
You need scalable layout values relative to screen width and breakpoints
You want to easily build adaptive views for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens
avoid_when: You are not using Material Design guidelines
You prefer another responsive layout solution like responsive_framework
strengths: Easy breakpoint management through context extensions
Supports fluid margins and customizable layout values
Includes AdaptiveBuilder for handling different screen sizes
weaknesses: Tied closely to Material Design layout conventions by default

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative approach for adapting and scaling UI across different screen sizes.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another popular package for building responsive UI using screen type builders.

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative for responsive sizing based on screen width and height percentages.
